verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical: the headline reflows well onto four centred lines, and the orange background, serif type and dark pill CTA are all kept. In A the CTA sits too low: there is about 130px of empty space above the headline but only about 55px below the button. The gap between headline and CTA (about 107px) is also much looser than in the original, so the button looks cut off from its message. B moves the CTA up about 10px, which tightens that gap and balances the top and bottom margins a little better. Its group is still slightly bottom-heavy, but it is closer to shippable.
